source.after: export function mapResponse(p){ const fail=()=>{throw new Error('Unsupported stock response')};if(!p||!Array.isArray(p.items))return fail();return p.items.map(x=>{if(!x||typeof x.sku!=='string'||typeof x.displayName!=='string'||!Number.isInteger(x.availableUnits)||x.availableUnits<0)return fail();return {sku:x.sku,available:x.availableUnits,label:x.displayName};});}

benchmark.scope: Three synthetic migrations, two fresh Bob Shell conditions each. Read/edit-only candidate generation with independent verification.

protocol.model: Bob Shell 2.0.5 default agent; same environment; explicit model selection unavailable in run help
protocol.tools: read/edit only; execute, MCP, skills, subagents and mode switching disabled in both conditions
protocol.commonInformation: identical contract, baseline source and baseline execution report
protocol.difference: guided receives a compact job checklist and failure index; no solution supplied
protocol.humanMetrics: Human time savings and usability are not measured. Runs orchestrated by Codex; no human editing during runs.
protocol.stop: Do not retry failed model runs. Record cost/turn failures as incomplete. Do not modify contract after seeing outcomes.
protocol.interpretation: Three deliberately constructed migrations; one fresh run per condition. Not a statistically generalizable productivity benchmark or an IDE comparison.

benchmark.conclusion: Both conditions passed all recorded checks in every case. This study establishes no correctness advantage for the prepared workflow. Elapsed times and costs are observations, not measured human productivity gains.

actual.error: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'available' in null

limitations: One run per condition per case.
Local work and an IDE session continued during runs; wall time is not a controlled performance benchmark.
No human usability or active work time was measured.
The compact guide reorganizes the same inputs; it provides no reference solution.
benchmark.supplementalNote: Post-study boundary review was added after observing results. It is reported separately and is not a preregistered or independent holdout benchmark. Passing seven sampled checks did not cover the entire written contract.
